system: E. coli chemotaxis (lab strain RP437-type, MeAsp, Mattingly et al. 2021 conditions)

loglat.definition: l / tau_fast, l = stimulus-to-motor latency, tau_fast = 1/lambda_tot (signal correlation time)

logR_proxy.definition: PROXY, not w*Var/h: fitness benefit of chemotaxis (Ni 2020, poor carbon) / proteome share of the signalling machinery
logR_proxy.rich_medium: benefit ~ 0 on glucose (Ni 2020): R_proxy < 1; the cell cuts motility investment there

lambda_tau2.meaning: slow-layer memory / world signal correlation time

tau1_over_tau_v.meaning: fast-layer time / world signal correlation time

taun_over_tau2.meaning: noise correlation time / memory: ~1 means the noise is the store's own

bp_share_of_noise.meaning: Berg-Purcell counting noise / measured kinase-noise variance (ecoli/results.json)

snr_armB.meaning: 2 sigma_u^2/(lambda N_s) at g = 0.1-0.4 /mm; scales as g^2

upkeep_share_proteome.meaning: signalling-machinery amino acids / all protein amino acids (ASSUMED total)

adaptation_power.meaning: Lan 2012: ~3x10^4 kT/s (~10^3 ATP/s), 5-10% of one flagellar motor's cost

benefit_fraction.meaning: relative fitness benefit of chemotaxis, poor carbon, Ni 2020 (read from text, not figures)
